Birth Doula Support in Long Beach & Orange County

Birth can bring so many feelings at once: excitement, curiosity, and a whole list of questions. You deserve space for all of them. I’m Mia, and I offer birth doula support to help you and your partner feel prepared, heard, and cared for as you welcome your baby.

Let’s Connect

A steady presence, shaped around you

Your preferences and hopes are where we begin. Together, we can explore what matters to you, talk through questions, and find practical ways to help you feel more comfortable. During labor, I bring emotional, physical, and informational support, with room for your experience to unfold in its own way. Partners are part of the picture, too: I’m here to help them feel involved and confident.

What support can include

  • Prenatal conversations about your birth preferences, hopes, and questions.
  • Education and resources to support preparation and informed decisions.
  • Continuous emotional and physical support throughout labor and birth.
  • Comfort measures including breathing, positioning, and movement.
  • Encouragement for partners and support with communicating your choices.
  • Two postpartum visits to reflect on your birth, answer questions, and help with the transition at home.

Is this support right for your family?

Whether this is your first baby or you’re preparing for a different experience this time, birth support can offer a familiar person in your corner. You don’t need to have every preference figured out before we talk.

Serving families close to home

I’m based in Los Alamitos and provide in-person doula care for families in Long Beach, Greater Los Angeles, and Orange County. Tell me where you’re planning to give birth when you reach out so we can discuss your plans and availability.

Kind words from families

Your questions, answered

Will you support my partner, too?

Yes! I help partners find practical ways to offer comfort, stay involved, and feel supported themselves. My role is to add to your team and honor the people you want beside you.

Does support continue after birth?

Birth doula support includes two postpartum visits. We can reflect on your experience, talk through questions, and support your family’s adjustment to life with your baby.

How do I find out about availability and pricing?

Use the contact form to share your due date, location, and the support you’re hoping for. We can discuss availability, current pricing, and whether working together feels like a good fit.

Let’s find your next step

You don’t have to figure it all out before we connect. Tell me what life looks like for your family and how you’d like to feel supported.
